plain_english: Now I speak the initiation that brings confidence to the deluded.
In the triangle, the fire's seat, blazing all around with the fire-letter, fanned by the wind-abode — on the left hand, fiercely blazing.
sanskrit_cite: trikoṇe vahnisadane vahnivarṇojjvale@bhitaḥ | vāyavyapuranirdhūte kare savye sujājvale

plain_english: Having taken a little seed — this very seed — likewise inside the heart and in the hand, being burned: let the true one, absorbed in its muttering, visualize it.
sanskrit_cite: bījaṃ kiṃcidgṛhītvaitattathaiva hṛdayāntare | kare ca dahyamānaṃ saccintayettajjapaikayuk

plain_english: Oppressed by the burning of the fire-kindled unbroken phaṭ-series, the seed goes to seedlessness, unable to fruit itself.
Roasted, it is not for sprouting; yet by that very proof — the karmas called mala and māyā, by force of mantra, meditation, and rite —
sanskrit_cite: taptaṃ naitatprarohāya tenaiva pratyayena tu | malamāyākhyakarmāṇi mantradhyānakriyābalāt

plain_english: burned up, not for their effect. But this seedlessness-proof the venerable, most gracious Śambhunātha demonstrated to me.
sanskrit_cite: dagdhāni na svakāryāya nirbījapratyayaṃ tvimam | sa śrīmānsuprasanno me śaṃbhunātho nyarūpayat

plain_english: And of the seed too, the joining is to be done here, by the guru's grace — since initiation, by brilliance, liberates even the immobile.
sanskrit_cite: bījasyāpyatra kāryā ca yojanā kṛpayā guroḥ | yato dīkṣā sudīptatvātsthāvarāṇyapi mocayet

plain_english: The guru who, having known in himself mastery of muttering, fire-offering, worship, and meditation, performs initiation — his initiation is held to carry visible proof.
sanskrit_cite: yo gururjapahomārcādhyānasiddhatvamātmani | jñātvā dīkṣāṃ carettasya dīkṣā sapratyayā smṛtā

plain_english: Not for the shaken-off, the conductless, the tattva-knower is this rule; by the conduct-bound is performed the initiation endowed with seen proof.
sanskrit_cite: avadhūte nirācāre tattvajñe natvayaṃ vidhiḥ | sācāraiḥ kriyate dīkṣā yā dṛṣṭapratyayānvitā

plain_english: By the conductless one no proof is declared in initiation — since knowledge is its own proof and deserves no further fruit.
sanskrit_cite: nirācāreṇa dīkṣāyāṃ pratyayastu na gadyate | jñānaṃ svapratyayaṃ yasmānna phalāntaramarhati

plain_english: 'Through the fruit, meditation and the rest are to be effected' — thus the Siddhāmata teaches; or let him perform the balance-purity test, the proof-joining one.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānādi tu phalātsādhyamiti siddhāmatoditam | tulāśuddhiparīkṣāṃ vā kuryātpratyayayoginīm

plain_english: As told in the venerable Tantrasadbhāva by the Supreme Lord — and in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra too this is indicated by the Supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: yathā śrītantrasadbhāve kathitā parameśinā | śrīpūrvaśāstre@pyeṣā ca sūcitā parameśinā

plain_english: Bliss, uprising, tremor, sleep, and whirling the fifth — thus says the teacher of śakti's gradation.
sanskrit_cite: ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nidrā ghūrṇiśca pañcamī | ityevaṃvadatā śaktitāratamyābhidhāyinā

plain_english: The uprising comes through lightness, from concealment of body-grasp; for the body is earthen and chief — then it abandons chiefness.
sanskrit_cite: udbhavo laghubhāvena dehagrahatirohiteḥ | deho hi pārthivo mukhyastadā mukhyatvamujjhati

plain_english: With the forthcoming-levitation mantra, having meditated the disciple floated up, let the guru perform there all the remaining rites as before stated.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvilāghavamantreṇa śiṣyaṃ dhyātvā samutplutam | karmāṇi tatrāśeṣāṇi pūrvoktānyācaredguruḥ

plain_english: Told is this very balance-purity initiation, the giver of proof.
